name: Time-Varying Contour Correspondence Computation
definition: A preprocessing algorithm to compute correspondence information of time-varying contours over all isovalues. It labels edges in $CT_{t+1}$ with sets of edges from $CT_t$.
summary: Time-Varying Contour Correspondence Computation tracks contour evolution by labeling contour tree edges with sets from previous time steps using Join and Split Trees to determine topological overlaps.
